# stalwart_tracer_stdout (Resource)

Defines a logging and tracing output method. Manages the Console variant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ansi` (Boolean) Whether to use ANSI colors in logs
- `buffered` (Boolean) Whether to buffer log entries before writing to console
- `enable` (Boolean) Enable or disable the tracer
- `events` (Set of String) List of events to include or exclude based on filter mode
- `events_policy` (String) How to interpret the events list
- `level` (String) The logging level for this tracer
- `lossy` (Boolean) Whether to drop log entries if there is backlog
- `multiline` (Boolean) Whether to write log entries as a single line or multiline

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
